newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank allots SKK2.9bln in repos, 15.99 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank allots SKK2.9bln in repos, 15.99 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Wednesday said it had allocated funds totalling 2.88 billion crowns at this morning's securities repurchase tender, at an average rate of 15.99 percent.
The NBS added that the tender offering a total of three billion crowns was undersubscribed, with all bids submitted being accepted.
At the NBS's last overnight repurchase tender on Tuesday, the average rate was 16.04 percent.
